source.author: ov
source.text: Tum denique concita mater, seu dolor hoc fecit seu sparsi causa veneni, exululat passisque fugit male sana capillis teque ferens parvum nudis, Melicerta, lacertis euhoe Bacche sonat.
source.text_original: Tum denique concita mater, / seu dolor hoc fecit seu sparsi causa veneni, / exululat passisque fugit male sana capillis / teque ferens parvum nudis, Melicerta, lacertis / 'euhoe Bacche' sonat.
source.text_english: Then at last the mother, roused, whether grief did this or the cause was the scattered poison, howls out and, with hair streaming loose, runs off madly, carrying you, little Melicerta, in her bare arms, and cries euhoe, Bacche.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hanc Panope Dotoque soror laetataque fluctu prosequitur nitidis pariter Galatea lacertis alta petens: Siculo revocat de litore Cyclops.
reuse.text_original: hanc Panope Dotoque soror laetataque fluctu / prosequitur nitidis pariter Galatea lacertis / alta petens: Siculo revocat de litore Cyclops.
reuse.text_english: To this one Panope, and her sister Doto, rejoicing in the wave, and Galatea too, with gleaming arms, follows, seeking the deep: the Cyclops recalls her from the Sicilian shore.
